data.name: HUG＆BETRAY
data.detailed_description:
[For streamers] HUG&BETRAY is a party psychology game designed to be streamed. Live streaming, recording, clips, shorts and monetization are all pre-approved for individuals, companies and agency talents — no permission needed. All music and SFX are original or fully licensed, so there is no Content ID risk. Hashtag: #ハグビット. Full guideline:

Hug, or Betray

Adorable plushies gathered in an ominous dark room.
Every round, all players secretly choose one of three actions — revealed at the same moment.

HUG — Trust and embrace. If everyone hugs, everyone survives
SWORD — Go for the betrayal: cut down a hugger
GUN — Smell the betrayal: shoot down the sword

45 seconds to think.

The real question isn't what you'll play.




It's what they'll play.

Every Lie Gets Exposed

In-game chat is wheel phrases and free comments. "I'm hugging," "Trust me this time," "Someone will betray us" — but nothing anyone says has to be true.
At the reveal, if words don't match actions, a red tag stabs into the message: "→ That was a lie."
The evidence of the betrayal stays on screen, in front of everyone.

Taunt, bluff, and rack up points.

Ever wanted to make your favorite streamer squirm?


Next round — can you still hug them?

The Stream IS the Game Board — A New Kind of Viewer-Participation Game

Until now, "viewer participation" streams meant playing on your own screen while the stream ran in the background — you joined your favorite streamer's game, but you barely watched their stream.

HUG&BETRAY flips that.　The game board is the stream itself.

The round table, the timer, the simultaneous reveal — it all happens on the streamer's screen. Viewers watch the stream and simply pick their move on their phone. No install needed — open a URL in your browser and take a seat at the table.

・Phones never show the results — at the reveal, every player's eyes are on the stream

・Manual host progression lets streamers commentate at their own pace

・Designed to work smoothly even with stream delay

Watch your favorite streamer's reaction — while you betray them.

Play with friends, with viewers, with strangers. Who'll be the sore loser howling at the moon?

Features

・Watch the stream, play from your phone — a new kind of viewer-participation game

・Cute plushies meet an ominous neon-lit dark room

・4–7 players + bot matches (playable solo)

・Fast psychological rounds — 10–15 minutes per match

・A cast of unique plushie characters

data.short_description: Hug, or betray. A psychological party game where everyone picks HUG, Sword, or Gun as the host calls each round. Taunt, bluff, and rack up points! A new kind of viewer-participation game — watch the stream, play from your phone! Who'll be the sore loser howling at the moon?

  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750 Ti / Radeon R7 260X / Intel UHD 630
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes:
